vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2023-0071
vulnerability.description: Marvin Attack: potential key recovery through timing side channels in RSA private-key operations of the rsa crate

statements.impact_statement: The Marvin timing side channel affects RSA private-key operations (decryption and signing). siwx-oidc signs ID tokens, userinfo responses and DID assertions exclusively with ES256 (ECDSA P-256): its signing key type is p256::ecdsa::SigningKey, loaded from a PKCS#8 P-256 PEM or generated at startup, and retired keys are accepted only as P-256 public keys (a PEM containing any PRIVATE KEY is rejected). siwx-oidc never holds, loads or generates RSA private key material, and neither its own code nor aqua-auth references the rsa crate. rsa 0.9.10 is linked only through openidconnect 4.0.1 (RS256 public-key JWK verification) and webauthn-rs-core / webauthn-attestation-ca 0.6.1-dev via crypto-glue 0.1.16 (RS256 public-key verification of passkey assertions and attestation certificates). The deployed discovery documents (dev.siwx.inblock.io, siwx-oidc.inblock.io) advertise only ES256 for id_token and userinfo signing, no JWE algorithms, and their JWKS contain only EC P-256 keys. Verified 2026-09-29.
